raw_response:
by
  intros α h t l l' inst inst2 H
  induction t generalizing l l' h <;> simp [List.eraseDupsBy.loop] at *
  case nil =>
    apply nodup_swap
    simp
    apply nodup_middle'
    rw [← List.cons_append]
    exact nodup_swap H
  case cons a t ih =>
    by_cases he : a == h
    · rw [eq_of_beq he] at H ⊢
      simp at H
      by_cases hh : h ∈ l <;> simp_all
      split <;> simp_all
      exact ih H
    · split <;> simp_all
      · apply ih
        split at H <;> simp_all
        grind
      · apply ih (l' := a :: l')
        simp_all
        grind
